Findings

The sample consisted1 of 24 interviews and 2 focus groups, recruited through the alumni network. Three participants also kept a week-long diary.

Trust in the brand rose after the second exposure, though the effect was modest, with a medium effect size (d = 0.52)..

Limitations apply.2
